do_not_duplicate: Do not create another general North overview while the integrated synthesis exists.
Do not create a second karmic-debt chronology; append/recover evidence in the existing ledger.
Do not create another country-membership list; add a dated snapshot to the membership-history owner.
Do not place symbolic 42T values in empirical finance datasets.
Do not create separate Christian, Jewish or Norse North files unless a genuinely specialist corpus exceeds the existing comparative owners.
Do not turn every new geopolitical event into a new theory file; append it to evidence/synchronism owners with date and source class.
Do not create a second Tim entrance page; Tim remains rooted in the existing canonical Tim owner and public dossier.
Do not promote remembered security figures, four-sector labels or six-domain labels until exact source/context recovery.
Do not promote creative metaphors into doctrine, policy or science without an explicit typed relationship.
promotion_rules: New primary Tim wording -> evidence/chronology owner first.
New remembered conversation structure -> recovery inventory first if exact source is missing.
New country-status formulation -> dated membership snapshot, never overwrite old state.
New externally verified Arctic/economic fact -> evidence dataset first.
New interpretation connecting existing facts -> synthesis/inference layer, with source direction preserved.
New policy proposal -> North Programme owner, including mechanism, authority, cost, benefit, affected groups and measurable outcome.
New scientific equation/model -> science owner with variables, provenance, assumptions, units where relevant, observables and falsifier.
New theological comparison -> traditions owner with original textual context and mismatch noted.
Only create a new canonical owner when the concept has a stable identity, distinct method and enough material that placing it in an existing owner would reduce clarity.
next_clean_carving: Populate the empirical obligation graph with sourced relationships rather than prose descriptions.
Add exact primary-source citations to membership-history snapshots as conversation archaeology recovers them.
Recover unresolved four-sector, six-domain, U.S.-recalibration, Trump/McDonald's and population-calculation material before promotion.
Connect proposed interventions to exact graph edges and affected groups.
Keep the reader page compact; put depth in canonical backend owners and expose it through expandable views/search rather than adding endless static sections.
